desc: The ESK – CZ Scorpion EVO 3 is an optimized safety selector lever kit for the CZ Scorpion EVO 3 platform that provides easier firing hand access to the weapon selector lever. A complimentary product to our MOE-EVO Grip, it’s also compatible with OEM and aftermarket grips. This kit maintains a Magpul aesthetic while enhancing functional use during high stress conditions with its enhanced ergonomics, ease of reach and employment, and user-configurable levers.
